caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a human figure, rendered in a way to resemble a wooden sculpture. The bust is positioned centrally on the paper, with the head turned slightly to the left, revealing the side of the face and the front of the torso. The figure has short, stylized hair and sharply defined facial features, including a prominent brow, nose, and lips. The shoulders and upper chest are also detailed, displaying angular lines and distinct carving marks characteristic of wood. The color palette consists mostly of shades of brown, representing the texture and grain of wood, with darker lines used for detailing and shading. The background is a plain, off-white or light beige color, which provides contrast to the central wooden bust, while the edges of the paper show some yellowing or discoloration. There are no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Carved Bust: Doll
